description: Search what this node's deskVerify keeps; a read, nothing is written. over "tests": the latest state of each test (its newest row), answering {suite, title, outcome, commit, at, failure} per item, filtered by suite (file name), test (words graded against the test's key and its failure text; a test they do not touch is left out), outcome (red or green), commit (a hash prefix), since (an ISO time; rows at or after it) current ("yes": only tests reported in their suite's latest run, what stands now), heading (a sub-heading: only the tests keyed "<heading> #<n>"; or one test's full key: that test) history ("yes": every row, each a flip, not only each test's newest) and slim ("yes": rows without commit and failure text). Since goal/G27.14 a test's key is its place, its sub-heading and its number under it, the same red or green. over "runs": each run it was handed (goal/G33.3), answering {state, outcome, started, ended, commit, dirty, suites: [{path, outcome, failures}], line}, filtered by suite (a path, or a file name: the runs that ran it), outcome (green, red, stopped, not run), commit and since (started at or after it). Every key but over is optional; a filter that does not belong to over is ignored. Answers {items: [{key, label: the row as json}], more, total}, newest first, bucket-bounded: more true means the answer is partial, so narrow the filters; total is how many matched in all.
